alignments.note: Interrogative μή: the ASV marks the question by inversion alone, so no English word answers to it (rule 44).
Verbless clause with no expressed subject; the existential *Is there* rides with the predicate noun (rules 68, 96).
No English determiner for God: rule 21's determinerless clause (rule 23).

μὴ γένοιτο rendered *God forbid*: neither English word answers to either token separately — *God* answers to nothing in the Greek and the negation is not spelled out — so the pair is one indivisible unit under rule 6. Leaving μή unrepresented and giving the whole idiom to the optative is the competing reading.

review_notes: A reference comparison will report the unrepresented interrogative μή as a disagreement; rule 44 says that report is not a correction.
*God forbid* is taken as noncompositional rather than split; the note records the alternative.
